Vashi.headText: Our center is led by a passionate and experienced Center Head, Nidhi Sheth, who is deeply committed to providing exceptional early childhood education. Nidhi serves as the driving force behind our educational programs, ensuring that the curriculum is innovative, engaging, and tailored to the developmental needs of children.

Aundh.headText: With the guidance of Ms. Aishwarya Powar, Kidzonia Aundh thrives as a space that promotes joyful learning and strong foundational values. Her leadership, commitment, and passion for early childhood development help create a warm, supportive, and inspiring environment.

Kamothe Sector 19.headText: As Associate Cluster Head and Center Head of Kharghar Sector 19, Mrs. Suranjana Das combines strategic thinking with a deep understanding of early years education. With an MBA in HR and extensive experience in managing multiple centers, she fosters innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
